verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair axis for a payments product with client SDKs, so the story applies. The pack shows a public GitHub repo for the Terminal JS SDK (install and ES-module usage notes), but nothing states an open-source license. Nothing shows that the core Terminal product, reader software or other SDKs are readable under an open license. The OpenAPI spec repo is an API description, not product source, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
